abstract: We study a signaling game where agents signal their type by choosing when to quit pursuing an uncertain project. High types observe news about project quality and quit when bad news arrives. Low types who do not observe any news may mimic high types by quitting continuously over a phase of time. The reputation dynamics may exhibit nonmonotonicity with respect to quitting time. Our analysis offers a unifying explanation for how and when both early and late quitting can enhance reputation and suggests novel welfare and policy implications.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个信号博弈模型，其中代理人通过选择何时放弃追求不确定项目来传递其类型信号。高类型者能观察到关于项目质量的新闻，并在坏消息到来时退出。未观察到任何新闻的低类型者可能通过在一段时间内持续退出，模仿高类型者的行为。声誉动态可能随退出时间呈现非单调性。我们的分析为早期和晚期退出如何及何时能提升声誉提供了统一的解释，并提出了新颖的福利与政策含义。
title: Signaling Vision: Knowing When to Quit

abstract: ABSTRACT Despite extensive research on the economic implications of COVID‐19, the inflationary consequences of lockdown remain underexplored. Prior impact assessments may be compromised due to the cross‐jurisdictional presence of lockdowns and the prevalence of the coronavirus. This study leverages a unique circumstance in Australia, where Melbourne was the only city under lockdown, to discern the impact of lockdown. By analysing granular supermarket price data and adjusting for intertemporal and geographical variation in COVID‐19 cases, policy stringency, and product availability, the study identifies a statistically significant and economically meaningful disinflationary effect on grocery prices attributable to lockdown. Excluding the specific disinflationary effect of lockdown, COVID‐19‐related stringency measures have a minimal impact on the prices of typical consumables such as food.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管关于COVID-19经济影响的研究已相当广泛，但封锁所带来的通胀后果仍未被充分探讨。由于封锁措施跨辖区存在以及新冠病毒的普遍流行，此前的影响评估可能受到削弱。本研究利用澳大利亚的一个独特情形，即墨尔本是唯一实施封锁的城市，以识别封锁的影响。通过分析细粒度的超市价格数据，并对COVID-19病例、政策严格程度以及产品可得性的跨期和地理差异进行调整，本研究识别出封锁对杂货价格产生了统计上显著且具有经济意义的抑制通胀效应。在排除封锁特定的抑制通胀效应后，与COVID-19相关的严格措施对食品等典型消费品价格的影响微乎其微。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: A Tale of Two Cities: Australian Evidence on the Effects of Lockdown on Grocery Inflation
title_zh: 双城记：澳大利亚关于封锁对食品杂货通胀影响的证据
